mapper.sql: id, user_id, login_identifier, username, display_name, auth_stage, login_result, failure_code, failure_reason, client_ip, user_agent, login_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_log ( user_id, login_identifier, username, display_name, auth_stage, login_result, failure_code, failure_reason, client_ip, user_agent, login_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{loginIdentifier}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{authStage}, #{loginResult}, #{failureCode}, #{failureReason}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, #{loginAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM sys_login_log WHERE ORDER BY login_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
